story.text: 승객 여러분, 오늘은 한복 매장 상공을 지나고 있습니다. 한복의 색과 예절에 담긴 이야기를 들려드릴게요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, o-neul-eun han-bok mae-jang sang-gong-eul ji-na-go it-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, today we're passing over a hanbok shop. Let me tell you the story behind hanbok's colors and etiquette.

story.text: 한복의 색은 아무렇게나 정해진 게 아니에요. '오방색'이라는 다섯 방위의 색(파랑·빨강·노랑·하양·검정)을 기본으로 해요.
story.reading: han-bok-ui saek-eun a-mu-reo-ke-na jeong-hae-jin ge a-ni-e-yo. o-bang-saek-i-ra-neun da-seot bang-wi-ui saek-eul gi-bon-eu-ro hae-yo.
story.en: Hanbok's colors aren't chosen at random. They're based on 'obangsaek' — the five directional colors (blue, red, yellow, white, black).

story.text: 위에 입는 짧은 상의는 '저고리'라고 해요. 소매의 곡선이 참 우아하죠.
story.reading: wi-e ib-neun jjal-beun sang-ui-neun jeo-go-ri-ra-go hae-yo.
story.en: The short top worn on the upper body is called 'jeogori'. The curve of the sleeve is quite elegant.

story.text: 아래에 넓게 퍼지는 치마는 그냥 '치마'라고 불러요. 걸을 때마다 우아하게 흔들리죠.
story.reading: a-rae-e neol-ge peo-ji-neun chi-ma-neun geu-nyang chi-ma-ra-go bul-leo-yo.
story.en: The wide, flowing skirt underneath is simply called 'chima'. It sways elegantly with every step.

story.text: 저고리를 여미는 긴 끈은 '옷고름'이라고 해요. 매듭을 예쁘게 묶는 것도 기술이랍니다.
story.reading: jeo-go-ri-reul yeo-mi-neun gin kkeun-eun ot-go-reum-i-ra-go hae-yo.
story.en: The long ribbon that ties the jeogori shut is called 'otgoreum'. Tying a pretty knot is quite a skill.

story.text: 한복을 입을 때는 '예절'도 중요해요. 앉을 때 치마를 정돈하는 것도 그중 하나죠.
story.en: 'Etiquette' matters when wearing hanbok too — like neatly arranging your skirt when sitting down.

story.text: 자, 오늘 배운 다섯 단어로 문제를 풀어볼까요? 아름다운 한복 이야기, 재미있으셨죠?
story.reading: ja, o-neul bae-un da-seot dan-eo-ro mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Now, shall we solve some questions with today's five words? Wasn't the story of beautiful hanbok fun?

words.example_en: Hanbok is made based on the five directional colors.
Jeogori refers to the top part of hanbok.
The chima skirt is made to flow wide.
Otgoreum is the ribbon that ties the jeogori shut.
There is etiquette even when wearing hanbok.

sentences.en: The five directional colors complete hanbok's beauty.
The jeogori has an elegant sleeve curve.
The chima sways elegantly with every step.
Tying a pretty otgoreum knot is also a skill.
Try wearing hanbok while following its etiquette.
